summary: RB Global filed an 8-K furnishing Q1 2026 results and declaring a $0.31/share cash dividend. The filing covers Items 2.02 (earnings release) and 8.01 (dividend declaration). GTV rose 13% to $4.3B, revenue up 11% to $1.2B, net income up 20% to $135.6M. There are no M&A, activist, restructuring, or other special-situation elements; this is a routine earnings and dividend announcement.
